Intro: There is no need for bribery. Proffering dessert after already being heaped with praise is excessive.
Though, this is a beautifully crafted dessert. It almost…reminds me of something.
I suppose I shouldn't turn down your generosity.
…it tastes of a memory that I cannot quite remember. But—something is different. There is something…bitter.
I was—wrong about you. You writhing, helpless thing.
No—matter. Watch this world fall apart without me—let them parade my corpse down the street.
